issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 04 asks to group sums of female and male inhabitants by Regierungsbezirk (the name of the Regierungsbezirk). The solution implementation (aufgabe04.sql) instead groups by 'kreis' (county) while selecting 'regierungsbezirk', which is a structural mismatch and may be invalid SQL or produce unintentionally aggregated results. This discrepancy will confuse students about the correct grouping level and prevents a direct mapping from the task description to the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution to match the problem statement by grouping by regierungsbezirk (e.g. CHANGE 'GROUP BY kreis' to 'GROUP BY regierungsbezirk'), so the query becomes: SELECT regierungsbezirk, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk. Alternatively, if the intended grouping was by 'kreis', update the problem statement to request grouping by Kreis instead.
